G'oya

Uchala ustunda ham bitta muammo: "ko'rsatilmagan" qiymat uch xil ko'rinishda keladi. NULLIF(TRIM(x), '') ularning hammasini bitta NULL ga aylantiradi: probellar kesiladi, bo'sh qolgan satr NULL bo'ladi. Shahar uchun yana COALESCE(..., 'noma''lum') qo'shiladi va guruhlash aynan shu tozalangan ifoda bo'yicha qilinadi. Qolgani shartli sanash: COUNT(CASE WHEN ... THEN 1 END).

Yechim

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(city), ''), 'noma''lum') AS city,
       COUNT(*) AS customers,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(phone), '') IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS no_phone,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(email), '') IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS no_email,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(phone), '') IS NOT NULL
                                 AND NULLIF(TRIM(email), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
             / COUNT(*), 1) AS complete_pct
FROM customers
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(city), ''), 'noma''lum')
ORDER BY customers DESC, city

Namunada Toshkentda uch mijoz: Aziz, Malika va Bekzod, shahar uch xil yozilgan. Bekzodning telefoni ikki probel, TRIM dan keyin bo'sh satr, NULLIF dan keyin NULL: u ham telefonsiz. To'liq ma'lumotli faqat Aziz, ulush 33.3. Dilnoza va Sardor noma'lum guruhida.

Tuzoqlar

Ustunga city deb nom berib, GROUP BY city yozsangiz, guruhlash tozalangan ifoda bo'yicha emas, jadvaldagi asl city ustuni bo'yicha bo'ladi. Ikkala baza ham GROUP BY dagi nomni avval jadval ustuni deb tushunadi. Natijada Toshkent uch qatorda chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(city), ''), 'noma''lum') AS city,
       COUNT(*) AS customers,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(phone), '') IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS no_phone,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(email), '') IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS no_email,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(phone), '') IS NOT NULL
                                 AND NULLIF(TRIM(email), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
             / COUNT(*), 1) AS complete_pct
FROM customers
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY customers DESC, city

Ifodani GROUP BY da to'liq yozing yoki GROUP BY 1 dan foydalaning. ORDER BY da esa nom aksincha, avval natija ustuni deb olinadi, shuning uchun ORDER BY city tozalangan shahar bo'yicha saralaydi.

TRIM siz NULLIF(phone, '') Bekzodning ikki probelli telefonini qiymat deb hisoblaydi. Faqat IS NULL tekshirilsa, Jasurning bo'sh emaili ham "bor" bo'lib qoladi.

100 deb yozsangiz (100.0 emas), bo'lish butun sonda bajariladi va 33.3 o'rniga 33 chiqadi.
